headline: Google reports controlled evaluation gains from Earth AI geospatial reasoning agent and expands experimental access
summary: Google Research’s Oct 14 announcement expands experimental access to its Geospatial Reasoning agent and links a technical report that compares four configurations around Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.8 Flash. In the paper’s 76 held-out open-ended GeoExpertQueries, GRA with Gemini 3.8 Flash scores 62.7/100, compared with 52.2 for the same model plus GRA’s geospatial tools without full planning and execution guidance, and 3.3 with basic tools. The full orchestration configuration does not improve the same test with Gemini 3.1 Pro (47.6 versus 50.8), making the added benefit model-dependent. The paper reports the largest gains from the specialized geospatial tool suite, introduces two benchmarks and releases their development splits. A material count mismatch remains: the paper reports 220 held-out GeoKTools queries, while the official v1.0.0 repository lists 210. These are author-reported results from one provider’s Gemini stack, not independent replications or field-deployment outcomes.
